Layout map objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_layout_map.Rd

Properties of layout.map.

Usage

go_layout_map(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  bearing = NULL,
  bounds = NULL,
  center = NULL,
  domain = NULL,
  fitbounds = NULL,
  layers = NULL,
  pitch = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  uirevision = NULL,
  zoom = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_bounds(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  east = NULL,
  north = NULL,
  south = NULL,
  west = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_center(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  lat = NULL,
  lon = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_domain(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  column = NULL,
  row = NULL,
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_layer(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  below = NULL,
  circle = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  coordinates = NULL,
  fill = NULL,
  line = NULL,
  maxzoom = NULL,
  minzoom = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  opacity = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  sourceattribution = NULL,
  sourcelayer = NULL,
  sourcetype = NULL,
  symbol = NULL,
  templateitemname = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_layer_circle(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  radius = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_layer_fill(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  outlinecolor = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_layer_line(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  dash = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_layer_symbol(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  icon = NULL,
  iconsize = NULL,
  placement = NULL,
  text = NULL,
  textfont = NULL,
  textposition = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_map_layer_symbol_textfont(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  color = NULL,
  family = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  weight = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

bearing

Sets the bearing angle of the map in degrees counter-clockwise from North (map.bearing). Number.

bounds

Named list or go_layout_map_bounds() object.

center

Named list or go_layout_map_center() object.

domain

Named list or go_layout_map_domain() object.

fitbounds

Determines if this subplot's view settings are auto-computed to fit trace data. If "locations" (default), the view is auto-fit to the lon/lat coordinates of the visible trace data. If FALSE, the view settings are used as-is; set this to opt out of auto-fitting. If `fitbounds` is enabled but a user provides `center` or `zoom`, auto-fit will be skipped. One of "locations", FALSE.

layers

List of named lists or go_layout_map_layer() objects.

pitch

Sets the pitch angle of the map (in degrees, where 0 means perpendicular to the surface of the map) (map.pitch). Number.

style

go_layout_map(): Defines the map layers that are rendered by default below the trace layers defined in `data`, which are themselves by default rendered below the layers defined in `layout.map.layers`. These layers can be defined either explicitly as a Map Style object which can contain multiple layer definitions that load data from any public or private Tile Map Service (TMS or XYZ) or Web Map Service (WMS) or implicitly by using one of the built-in style objects which use WMSes or by using a custom style URL Map Style objects are of the form described in the MapLibre GL JS documentation available at https://maplibre.org/maplibre-style-spec/ The built-in plotly.js styles objects are: basic, carto-darkmatter, carto-darkmatter-nolabels, carto-positron, carto-positron-nolabels, carto-voyager, carto-voyager-nolabels, dark, light, open-street-map, outdoors, satellite, satellite-streets, streets, white-bg. Any value.

go_layout_map_layer_symbol_textfont(): Sets whether a font should be styled with a normal or italic face from its family. One of "normal", "italic".

uirevision

Controls persistence of user-driven changes in the view: `center`, `zoom`, `bearing`, `pitch`. Defaults to `layout.uirevision`. Any value.

zoom

Sets the zoom level of the map (map.zoom). Number.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

east

Sets the maximum longitude of the map (in degrees East) if `west`, `south` and `north` are declared. Number.

north

Sets the maximum latitude of the map (in degrees North) if `east`, `west` and `south` are declared. Number.

south

Sets the minimum latitude of the map (in degrees North) if `east`, `west` and `north` are declared. Number.

west

Sets the minimum longitude of the map (in degrees East) if `east`, `south` and `north` are declared. Number.

lat

Sets the latitude of the center of the map (in degrees North). Number.

lon

Sets the longitude of the center of the map (in degrees East). Number.

column

If there is a layout grid, use the domain for this column in the grid for this map subplot. Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

row

If there is a layout grid, use the domain for this row in the grid for this map subplot. Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

x

Sets the horizontal domain of this map subplot (in plot fraction). Vector or list of 2 element(s).

y

Sets the vertical domain of this map subplot (in plot fraction). Vector or list of 2 element(s).

below

Determines if the layer will be inserted before the layer with the specified ID. If omitted or set to ”, the layer will be inserted above every existing layer. String.

circle

Named list or go_layout_map_layer_circle() object.

color

go_layout_map_layer(): Sets the primary layer color. If `type` is "circle", color corresponds to the circle color (map.layer.paint.circle-color) If `type` is "line", color corresponds to the line color (map.layer.paint.line-color) If `type` is "fill", color corresponds to the fill color (map.layer.paint.fill-color) If `type` is "symbol", color corresponds to the icon color (map.layer.paint.icon-color) Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

go_layout_map_layer_symbol_textfont(): Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

coordinates

Sets the coordinates array contains [longitude, latitude] pairs for the image corners listed in clockwise order: top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left. Only has an effect for "image" `sourcetype`. Any value.

fill

Named list or go_layout_map_layer_fill() object.

line

Named list or go_layout_map_layer_line() object.

maxzoom

Sets the maximum zoom level (map.layer.maxzoom). At zoom levels equal to or greater than the maxzoom, the layer will be hidden. Number in the interval [0, 24].

minzoom

Sets the minimum zoom level (map.layer.minzoom). At zoom levels less than the minzoom, the layer will be hidden. Number in the interval [0, 24].

name

When used in a template, named items are created in the output figure in addition to any items the figure already has in this array. You can modify these items in the output figure by making your own item with `templateitemname` matching this `name` alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). Has no effect outside of a template. String.

opacity

Sets the opacity of the layer. If `type` is "circle", opacity corresponds to the circle opacity (map.layer.paint.circle-opacity) If `type` is "line", opacity corresponds to the line opacity (map.layer.paint.line-opacity) If `type` is "fill", opacity corresponds to the fill opacity (map.layer.paint.fill-opacity) If `type` is "symbol", opacity corresponds to the icon/text opacity (map.layer.paint.text-opacity) Number in the interval [0, 1].

source

Sets the source data for this layer (map.layer.source). When `sourcetype` is set to "geojson", `source` can be a URL to a GeoJSON or a GeoJSON object. When `sourcetype` is set to "vector" or "raster", `source` can be a URL or an array of tile URLs. When `sourcetype` is set to "image", `source` can be a URL to an image. Any value.

sourceattribution

Sets the attribution for this source. String.

sourcelayer

Specifies the layer to use from a vector tile source (map.layer.source-layer). Required for "vector" source type that supports multiple layers. String.

sourcetype

Sets the source type for this layer, that is the type of the layer data. One of "geojson", "vector", "raster", "image".

symbol

Named list or go_layout_map_layer_symbol() object.

templateitemname

Used to refer to a named item in this array in the template. Named items from the template will be created even without a matching item in the input figure, but you can modify one by making an item with `templateitemname` matching its `name`, alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). If there is no template or no matching item, this item will be hidden unless you explicitly show it with `visible: true`. String.

type

Sets the layer type, that is the how the layer data set in `source` will be rendered With `sourcetype` set to "geojson", the following values are allowed: "circle", "line", "fill" and "symbol". but note that "line" and "fill" are not compatible with Point GeoJSON geometries. With `sourcetype` set to "vector", the following values are allowed: "circle", "line", "fill" and "symbol". With `sourcetype` set to "raster" or "image", only the "raster" value is allowed. One of "circle", "line", "fill", "symbol", "raster".

visible

Determines whether this layer is displayed Logical.

radius

Sets the circle radius (map.layer.paint.circle-radius). Has an effect only when `type` is set to "circle". Number.

outlinecolor

Sets the fill outline color (map.layer.paint.fill-outline-color). Has an effect only when `type` is set to "fill". Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

dash

Sets the length of dashes and gaps (map.layer.paint.line-dasharray). Has an effect only when `type` is set to "line". Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

width

Sets the line width (map.layer.paint.line-width). Has an effect only when `type` is set to "line". Number.

icon

Sets the symbol icon image (map.layer.layout.icon-image). Full list: https://www.mapbox.com/maki-icons/ String.

iconsize

Sets the symbol icon size (map.layer.layout.icon-size). Has an effect only when `type` is set to "symbol". Number.

placement

Sets the symbol and/or text placement (map.layer.layout.symbol-placement). If `placement` is "point", the label is placed where the geometry is located If `placement` is "line", the label is placed along the line of the geometry If `placement` is "line-center", the label is placed on the center of the geometry One of "point", "line", "line-center".

text

Sets the symbol text (map.layer.layout.text-field). String.

textfont

Sets the icon text font (color=map.layer.paint.text-color, size=map.layer.layout.text-size). Has an effect only when `type` is set to "symbol". Named list or go_layout_map_layer_symbol_textfont() object.

textposition

Sets the positions of the `text` elements with respects to the (x,y) coordinates. One of "top left", "top center", "top right", "middle left", "middle center", "middle right", "bottom left", "bottom center", "bottom right".

family

HTML font family - the typeface that will be applied by the web browser. The web browser can only apply a font if it is available on the system where it runs. Provide multiple font families, separated by commas, to indicate the order in which to apply fonts if they aren't available. String.

size

Number in the interval [1, Inf].

weight

Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. Integer in the interval [1, 1000].

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_layout_map() and the nested object constructors below create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()).

layout.map.layer.symbol.textfont: Sets the icon text font (color=map.layer.paint.text-color, size=map.layer.layout.text-size). Has an effect only when `type` is set to "symbol".
